description.narrative: (i) generate value added and create 522 direct jobs and 670 indirect jobs along the value chain (ii) strengthen the local economy by generating forex inflows through increased exports (iii) reduce Green House Gas (GHG) emissions through the expansion of renewable energy use (solar energy) and reduction of food loss (iv) improve competitiveness of vegetables and fruits market through increased production and diversified product offerings and vertical integration to increase productivity and quality of products in an environment constrained by climate change (v) strengthen integration of local value chains with global value chains.

The proposed investment in ZZ2 Beherend Pty Limited (ZZ2 or the Group) is to finance expansion of avocado production, expansion of tomato production in net houses, investments in solar energy for its farm operations and refinance part of its existing debt (the Project).
